sources.title: CLIP Model Configurations | zhuoyan-xu/Foundation-Model_Multitask ...
sources.snippet: This document provides a comprehensive overview of CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) model configurations used throughout the Foundation Model Multitask repository. It covers the configuration structure, supported model variants, training approaches, and dataset-specific adaptations for CLIP-based few-shot learning experiments.
